question.text: What is the significance of SEBI's February 2020 circular regarding mutual fund transactions through stock exchange platforms?

answer.text: It mandated that all mutual fund transactions must go through stock exchange platforms
It introduced settlement guarantee for mutual fund transactions on exchange platforms
It allowed investors to directly access stock exchange mutual fund infrastructure without necessarily going through a broker
It restricted exchange platforms to only process transactions above Rs. 1 lakh

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's circular dated February 26, 2020 allowed investors to directly access stock exchange infrastructure to purchase and redeem mutual fund units directly from mutual funds/AMCs (workbook p. 118). The Trap: Option A overstates the circular — it permits, but does not mandate, exclusive use of exchange platforms. Option B is incorrect because the workbook still notes the absence of a settlement guarantee for these transactions. Option D fabricates a minimum-amount threshold not present in the workbook. Note: Workbook pp. 117-118 also describe trading members and distributors with limited-purpose exchange membership, so prior access was not exclusively through a registered broker.
